title: The one-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes equations in critical regularity spaces
summary: We are concerned with the barotropic compressible Navier-Stokes equations on the real line. Our primary goal is to establish the global well-posedness in a critical regularity framework in the case where the initial data are small perturbations of a stable constant state. Surprisingly, even though the result in the multi-dimensional case is by now classical, the one-dimensional case has not been elucidated yet as far as we know.
